description: Assemble and render the TDAR↔infection AOP network diagram
code:
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, FancyBboxPatch
import networkx as nt

# node: id -> (label, layer_x, y, type, aop_color)
# We'll position manually in a left->right flow. Layers by biological level.
nodes = {
 # AOP 154 (blue)  calcineurin
 '980':("Inhibition of\nCalcineurin\n[MIE-154]",0,4,'MIE','#1f77b4'),
 '979':("Interference NFAT\nnuclear localization\n[KE-154]",1,4,'KE','#1f77b4'),
 '981':("Reduced NFAT/AP-1\ncomplex\n[KE-154]",2,4,'KE','#1f77b4'),
 '1202':("Suppression\nIL-2 & IL-4\n[KE-154]",3,4,'KE','#1f77b4'),
 # AOP 277 (green) IL-1R1
 '1700':("Impaired IL-1R1\nsignaling in T cell\n[MIE-277]",0,2.0,'MIE','#2ca02c'),
 '202':("Inhibition of\nNF-κB\n[KE-277 & 14]",1.5,1.0,'KE','#9467bd'),  # shared -> purple
 '1702':("Suppression of\nT-cell activation\n[KE-277]",3,2.0,'KE','#2ca02c'),
 # AOP 315 (orange) JAK3
 '1715':("Inhibition of\nJAK3\n[MIE-315]",0,6,'MIE','#ff7f0e'),
 '1716':("Blockade STAT5\nphosphorylation\n[KE-315]",1,6,'KE','#ff7f0e'),
 '1717':("Suppressed STAT5\npromoter binding\n[KE-315]",2,6,'KE','#ff7f0e'),
 '1718':("Suppression\nIL-4\n[KE-315]",3,6,'KE','#ff7f0e'),
 # shared TDAR AO
 '984':("Impairment of\nTDAR (AO)\n[AO-154 & 277]",4.3,4,'AO','#d62728'),
 '1719':("Impairment of\nTDAR (AO)\n[AO-315]",4.3,6,'AO','#d62728'),
 # AOP 14 (purple) GR -> disease susceptibility
 '122':("Glucocorticoid\nReceptor activation\n[MIE-14]",0,-0.4,'MIE','#8c564b'),
 '145':("Induction IκB\ninhibitory protein\n[KE-14]",0.8,-0.4,'KE','#8c564b'),
 '152':("Suppression\ninflammatory cytokines\n[KE-14]",2.5,-0.2,'KE','#8c564b'),
 '168':("Decreased\nlymphocytes\n[KE-14]",3.4,-0.4,'KE','#8c564b'),
 '403':("Suppression of\nimmune system\n[KE-14/84/85]",4.3,-0.4,'KE','#8c564b'),
 '323':("Increased Disease\nSusceptibility (AO)\n[AO-14]",5.6,1.4,'AO','#d62728'),
 'INF':("INCREASED\nSUSCEPTIBILITY\nTO INFECTION\n(original AOP-277 AO)",5.6,3.4,'AOX','#111111'),
}
edges = [
 ('980','979'),('979','981'),('981','1202'),('1202','984'),
 ('1700','202'),('202','1702'),('1702','984'),
 ('1715','1716'),('1716','1717'),('1717','1718'),('1718','1719'),
 ('122','145'),('145','202'),('202','152'),('152','168'),('168','403'),('403','323'),
]
# conceptual / cross-AOP linkages (dashed)
dashed = [
 ('984','INF'),   # impaired TDAR -> infection (Luster quantitative + clinical WoE)
 ('1719','INF'),
 ('1702','INF'),  # original AOP-277 KER
 ('323','INF'),   # disease susceptibility encompasses infection
 ('1202','1718'), # IL-4 suppression convergence
]

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(17,10))
def draw_node(nid):
    lab,x,y,typ,col=nodes[nid]
    x=x*2.3; y=y*1.15
    w,h=1.75,0.85
    style="round,pad=0.02"
    lw=3 if typ in('AO','AOX') else 1.6
    ec='black'
    fc=col
    alpha=0.9 if typ!='KE' else 0.75
    box=FancyBboxPatch((x-w/2,y-h/2),w,h,boxstyle=style,linewidth=lw,edgecolor=ec,facecolor=fc,alpha=alpha,zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    tc='white' if typ in ('MIE','AO','AOX') or col in('#9467bd','#8c564b','#d62728','#111111','#1f77b4','#2ca02c') else 'black'
    ax.text(x,y,lab,ha='center',va='center',fontsize=7.3,color='white',zorder=4,fontweight='bold' if typ in('AO','AOX','MIE') else 'normal')
    return (x,y,w,h)
pos={}
for nid in nodes: 
    lab,x,y,typ,col=nodes[nid]; pos[nid]=(x*2.3,y*1.15)
for nid in nodes: draw_node(nid)
def arrow(a,b,dashed=False,color='black'):
    x1,y1=pos[a]; x2,y2=pos[b]
    ar=FancyArrowPatch((x1,y1),(x2,y2),arrowstyle='-|>',mutation_scale=15,
        lw=1.8 if not dashed else 1.6,color=color,linestyle='--' if dashed else '-',
        connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.06",shrinkA=26,shrinkB=26,zorder=2,alpha=0.85)
    ax.add_patch(ar)
for a,b in edges: arrow(a,b)
for a,b in dashed: arrow(a,b,dashed=True,color='#d62728' if b=='INF' else '#555555')

# legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
leg=[Patch(color='#ff7f0e',label='AOP 315 – JAK3 inhibition'),
     Patch(color='#1f77b4',label='AOP 154 – Calcineurin inhibition (endorsed)'),
     Patch(color='#2ca02c',label='AOP 277 – Impaired IL-1R1 signaling'),
     Patch(color='#8c564b',label='AOP 14 – Glucocorticoid Receptor activation'),
     Patch(color='#9467bd',label='Shared KE 202 (NF-κB) : bridge 277→14'),
     Patch(color='#d62728',label='Adverse Outcome (TDAR / Disease susceptibility)'),
     Patch(color='#111111',label='Infection outcome (historical AOP-277 AO)')]
ax.legend(handles=leg,loc='lower left',fontsize=9,framealpha=0.95)
ax.text(6.4*2.3,7.4*1.15,"AOP NETWORK: Immunosuppression → Impaired TDAR → Increased Susceptibility to Infection",
        fontsize=13,fontweight='bold',ha='center')
ax.text(6.4*2.3,7.0*1.15,"Dashed red = TDAR→infection linkage (Luster 1993 near-linear immune→host-resistance; clinical WoE). Dashed grey = cross-AOP convergence.",
        fontsize=8.5,ha='center',color='#333333')
ax.set_xlim(-2.5,15.5); ax.set_ylim(-1.8,9.2); ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("tdar_infection_aop_network.png",dpi=140,bbox_inches='tight')
print("saved network figure")
print("Nodes:",len(nodes),"Solid KERs:",len(edges),"Cross-links:",len(dashed))
